# Slash commands

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-commands-doc.mjs from src/commands/*/*.cmd.ts. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run docs:commands`. -->

48 commands, by function (the folders of `src/commands/`). Free text typed without a leading `/` goes to `/assistant`.
An **async** command starts a crew and returns a ticket; its result is printed when the crew completes.

## The session

| Command | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/assistant` | async | Ask the interactive coding agent to work on a request. |
| `/btw` | sync | Inject a side note into the session context ("by the way…"). |
| `/clear` | sync | Clear the conversation buffer and the screen. Also `/reset-session`. |
| `/compact` | async | Compact the session buffer to free up context; text after it names what the summary must keep; --snip [N] only keeps the head and the last N exchanges. |
| `/copy` | sync | Re-print the last assistant output in full (terminal copy; no OS clipboard). |
| `/exit` | sync | Exit the coding-agent REPL. |
| `/export` | sync | Export the session (conversation + memory + cost) to a markdown file. |
| `/rename` | sync | Set the current session's title. |
| `/resume` | sync | List this project's saved sessions; /resume <number or id> brings one back in place of this session. |
| `/rewind` | sync | Rewind the session by one exchange (drops the last user turn and what followed). |
| `/summary` | async | Generate an LLM summary of the session (read-only; does not rewrite the buffer). |
| `/tasks` | async | Session task list (add, done, clear), the approvals the background tasks wait on, and the agent instances of the dev crews: list, show, stop, send, repair by a new run. |

## Settings

| Command | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/advisor` | async | Show, set or disable the advisor model, or run a second opinion on the last answer. |
| `/agents` | sync | List, add, show or remove saved agent configurations (.orkeon/agents.json). |
| `/config` | sync | List, get, set or unset settings over the declared key space (file + session layers). |
| `/effort` | sync | Show or set the session reasoning-effort level (low\|medium\|high). |
| `/fast` | sync | Toggle fast mode (drop the advisory prompt blocks for latency). |
| `/hooks` | sync | List, add or remove declarative hooks (pre-tool\|post-tool\|stop). |
| `/mode` | sync | Cycle, show or set the session-default permission mode of the assistant; /plan toggles plan mode (read-only). Also `/plan`. |
| `/model` | sync | Show the effective model for the next turn, or switch it without relaunching. |
| `/output-style` | sync | Show or set the session's answer style (consumed by the assistant's prompt). |
| `/permissions` | sync | Show the permission surface; add, remove, list or clear the session's tool rules. |
| `/proactive` | sync | Toggle proactive follow-up suggestions from the assistant. |
| `/skills` | sync | List, attach or detach skill files (workspace markdown playbooks). |

## Status and usage

| Command | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/context` | sync | Show the current session context: title, model, messages, tokens (by kind when the host reports them), pressure, cache tokens. Also `/ctx-viz`. |
| `/doctor` | sync | Health check: toolchain, LLM configuration, tool catalogue and VFS mounts. |
| `/release-notes` | sync | Show the release notes for this build. |
| `/status` | sync | Show the session status: model, provider, workspace, context, cost, crews, version, runtime and platform. Also `/version`, `/env`, `/session`, `/upgrade`. |
| `/usage` | sync | Show token usage against the context window (pressure tier, compaction trigger), calls, tokens, cost and the cache tokens read and written, then the usage by model and by command. Also `/extra-usage`, `/stats`, `/cost`. |

## The project

| Command | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/analyze` | async | Analyze the codebase deterministically (index → maps → dependency graph) and synthesize business objects + dependencies; --raw prints the harvest without any LLM call. |
| `/debug-tool-call` | sync | Invoke a registered tool with JSON arguments and print its raw result. |
| `/files` | sync | List the files in a directory (defaults to /workspace). |
| `/init` | async | Analyse the workspace and write AGENTS.md, the instructions file (an existing CLAUDE.md is merged). |
| `/init-verifiers` | async | Detect test tooling and author verification skills for uncovered zones. |
| `/verify` | async | Check the project by running it, following the verification skills /init-verifiers wrote (one zone, or all). |

## Git and review

| Command | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/branch` | sync | Show the current git branch, or check out the given one (refuses on a dirty tree). |
| `/commit` | async | Draft and create a conventional commit of the changed files or the paths named, the work folder left out unless named (confirms first; --yes skips; --push pushes; --pr opens the pull request). |
| `/diff` | sync | Show the working-tree diff, or the staged diff with --staged. |
| `/review` | async | Run a multi-lens code review on staged changes; --lens correctness\|security\|style keeps one lens, --passes 1-5 sets this run's rounds. Also `/security-review`, `/passes`. |

## The dev workflow

| Command | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/dev-batches` | async | Run a plan's batches in dependency order (implement, audit, commit each), --concurrency n at once in worktrees, then one PR; <code> F<n>: one batch; F<n> --audit: its audit. Also `/dev-implement`, `/dev-verify`. |
| `/dev-learn` | async | Turn gaps that recur across dev batches into proposals (--list: the backlog; --accept/--refuse: decide). |
| `/dev-plan` | async | Plan a settled spec or change brief as batches: plan, one sheet per batch, a read-only review (--replace: plan again). |
| `/dev-spec` | async | Write or revise a business spec, or with a kind (bug, refactor, perf) a change brief proven by running; its open questions one at a time, then a read-only review. Also `/dev-change`. |
| `/dev-status` | sync | Show where a piece of dev work stands: batches, TDD ticks and last verdict (read-only). |

## Memory

| Command | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/memory` | async | List, add, delete, or get typed memory entries (user/project/feedback/reference); admit decides the shared memory's candidates (--list, --refuse <id>, --import). Also `/feedback`, `/memory-admit`. |

## Speech

| Command | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/say` | async | Read a text aloud, or the assistant's last answer with no text (speech MCP server); --stop cuts the reading. |
| `/transcribe` | async | Transcribe an audio or video file under /audio (Whisper MCP server); --then runs an instruction on the transcription, --list shows the files. |
| `/voice` | async | Dictate a request: record the microphone until a silence and show the text; /voice send sends it, --go sends at once. |
